title.zh: Google Says AI Isn't Building Itself Yet—Even Though It Writes 75% of the Code
title.en: Google Says AI Isn't Building Itself Yet—Even Though It Writes 75% of the Code

current_state.zh: Google DeepMind's Gemini 4 Argon safety report found no statistically significant acceleration in AI research progress despite AI now writing more than 75% of the lab's production code, with about 88% of changes still needing human direction and the model solving only about half of internal research engineering tasks.
current_state.en: Google DeepMind's Gemini 4 Argon safety report found no statistically significant acceleration in AI research progress despite AI now writing more than 75% of the lab's production code, with about 88% of changes still needing human direction and the model solving only about half of internal research engineering tasks.
